The scatter plot above gives the correspondence between the variables $x$ and $y$ for some data points.
The equation of the trend line is $y=27-0.5x.$ Assuming this trend continues, estimate the value of $y$ when $x=16.$
question.worked_solution:
We can estimate the required value by substituting $x=16$ into the equation of the trend line:

$$
\begin{aligned}y & =27-0.5x \\  & =27-0.5(16) \\  & =27-8 \\  & =19\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, according to this model, when $x=16,$ we have $y≈19.$

Note: The point where $x=16$ is not shown on our trend line. Therefore, our result *may* be unreliable.
